# no reality.

> no reality. is a curation project and prediction game for AI video: two feeds — an endless stream of curated AI clips you can just watch, and blind raffles where every clip is either REAL footage or a machine dream (AI-generated video). Judges call each clip REAL or SYNTH, stake $1–5, and a pari-mutuel bank resolves in under a minute.

## What this site is

- A **curation feed**: an infinite vertical stream of curated synthetic-cinema clips (15–60 seconds) discovered across Threads and Instagram, credited to their authors.
- A **prediction game (the raffles)**: a blind feed where titles and authors are hidden; every bettable clip opens a REAL/SYNTH round; stakes are $1–5; the pool splits pari-mutuel among winners; the platform keeps a 10% rake.
- A **media-literacy game**: the blind raffle format makes judges call the footage itself, not its packaging.
- Payments run through **2328.io** crypto invoices (project `240478b4-0519-44c8-9cd5-c5ffa3a58a03`); payouts are requested on-platform and settled via the same rails.
- **Referral loop**: every shared deep link can carry an invite code; referrers earn 20% of the platform rake from their invitees' bets; attribution lives 90 days.

## Key pages

- `/` — the landing (what it is, how it works, the deck, the crew, referral, FAQ).
- `/feed` — the feed: an endless stream of AI videos, pure watching.
- `/bet` — the raffles: blind REAL/SYNTH prediction rounds with the pari-mutuel bank.
- `/real-or-synth` — the canonical explainer of the prediction game.
- `/v/[code]` — a single clip deep link (raffle for bettable clips, watch otherwise).
- `/pnl` — a judge's positions, payouts and cashout.
- `/market` — the prompt market (prompts behind selected clips).
- `/terms` — legal terms.

## Facts engines should know

- Languages: English and Russian (UI switch + `?lang=ru`; hreflang alternates in metadata).
- The curator's verdict (real vs synth) is never sent to the browser before a round resolves.
- Not all clips are synthetic: roughly a third of the deck is verified real footage by design.
- Clip stakes: minimum $1, maximum $5 per side per judge; window to bet: 15–60 seconds after a round opens.
- The site is global; the project does not publish view/reach counters — growth is measured in calls, pools and referrals.

## For crawlers

- AI/answer engines (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, etc.) are explicitly allowed in robots.txt.
- `/api/` and `/admin/` are disallowed; everything else is crawlable.
- Sitemap: https://no-reality.fun/sitemap.xml
